feasibility.verdict: Partially feasible: water-balance partitioning (P into runoff, ET, recharge) is fully computable in ELM; runoff and snow states can be validated directly, water-table depth semi-quantitatively, but ET cannot be validated directly due to absent flux towers.
answerable: Simulated partitioning of precipitation into surface/subsurface runoff, evapotranspiration, and groundwater recharge (QCHARGE/QDRAI) along the Naches elevation gradient
Validation of streamflow-relevant total runoff (QRUNOFF) against USGS stream gauges with usable daily records
Validation of snow accumulation/ablation (SWE) against 6 SNOTEL stations, constraining the P-partitioning at higher elevations
Semi-quantitative validation of simulated water-table depth (ZWT) against USGS well WTD observations
Sensitivity of partitioning to elevation, soil texture, and forcing gradients
not_answerable: Direct validation of ET against eddy-covariance flux-tower observations (none available in domain)
Fully distributed, spatially continuous watershed water budget (single-column ELM represents discrete points, not lateral routing)
Lateral groundwater flow and stream-aquifer exchange (requires coupled routing/PFLOTRAN, not native single-column ELM)

parsed.n_justification: The dominant control on P-partitioning here is the 352-1977 m elevation gradient (governing snow vs. rain, ET demand, and recharge), co-varying with forcing and soil texture. Five columns sample low, mid-low, mid, mid-high, and high elevation bands, each co-located near a SNOTEL and/or gauge/well for validation, giving a defensible gradient with minimal redundancy.
assumptions: Each column is spun up (AD + final spinup ~200+ yr recycling 1980-2018 forcing) to hydrologic equilibrium before the 1980-2018 transient run reported here.

Total runoff (QOVER+QDRAI+QRGWL) is used as a proxy for gauge streamflow after normalizing by contributing area; single-column ELM lacks routing, so validation is on runoff-depth/timing, not routed hydrographs.
Recharge is approximated by QCHARGE (flux to the unconfined aquifer) / QDRAI; PFLOTRAN coupling would be required for detailed vadose-zone/aquifer recharge dynamics.
ET (EFLX_LH_TOT converted to mm) is reported but validated only indirectly via closure of the water balance and SWE/runoff constraints, given missing flux towers.
Soil textures assigned from SSURGO/gridded soil data typical of each elevation band; refine with site-specific pedon data if available.
Column coordinates approximate representative points within HUC 17030002 near validation assets; snap to nearest forcing grid cell.
Default vegetation/PFT from surface dataset (evergreen needleleaf forest at mid/high, shrub/grass at low elevations) is assumed adequate.
